layman_headline: Market is cooling after a massive rally — hold what we have, don't chase.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market surged this past week — Bitcoin up 22%, Ethereum up 28%, and many altcoins up 30-60%. But in the last 24 hours, almost everything is pulling back 2-6%, which is normal after such a big move. Our Solana position is up 7.4% and approaching its profit target of $100, while our XRP position is down 5.8% after we entered near a local high. There are no fresh setups with good risk/reward right now — everything that ran hard is either overbought or pulling back, and the new candidates are stablecoins or already-extended tokens.
layman_action: Hold both current positions. SOL is working well — let it ride toward the $100 target. Watch XRP closely; it's underwater but still above the $1.30 stop-loss. Don't add new positions into this pullback until things settle.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates present poor entry conditions: PUMP has RSI 86 (deeply overbought with +69.5% 7d move), XRP and SOL are already held, MON and VVV have run 31-38% in a week with no RSI/MACD data to confirm continuation, and the remaining candidates are stablecoins. BTC dominance at 59.4% signals capital concentration in BTC rather than alt rotation, and the Fear & Greed index dropped from 71 to 66 in 24 hours suggesting momentum is fading. The smart play is capital preservation: let SOL approach $100 target and monitor XRP for stop-loss proximity at $1.30. Opening new positions into an extended, cooling market with high BTC dominance violates swing trading discipline.
risk_factors: XRP could continue declining toward the $1.30 stop-loss if the broad pullback extends beyond a 1-day dip
BTC dominance at 59.4% may compress further, dragging altcoin positions lower even if BTC holds
The entire rally was squeeze-driven rather than fundamental — reversals from such moves can be sharp and violent
watch_list: SOL price action near $95-100 resistance zone — take profit if it reaches $100
XRP price behavior around $1.40 support — if it breaks below $1.35, consider early exit before stop-loss
BTC holding $75,000 support — a break below would signal the rally is reversing and risk all alt positions
market_context: Crypto just experienced a massive squeeze-led rally with BTC up 22% and alts up 20-60% in one week. The market is now in a natural cooling phase with broad 24-hour pullbacks, and BTC dominance remains elevated at 59.4%, limiting alt season potential.
context_banner: Post-squeeze cooldown phase — protect gains and wait for pullback entries rather than chasing extended moves.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed dropped from 71 to 66 in 24 hours, signaling fading momentum after the rally — not the time to add risk.
PUMP RSI at 86 confirms the only active momentum candidate is dangerously overbought; no safe entries available.
ZEC volume at $1.8B with +61% 7d move and Zcash ETF news is notable, but the move is already extended and we lack RSI confirmation.
Zcash jumped 48% on Grayscale spot ETF filing — a powerful catalyst but the move appears largely priced in after a 61% weekly surge.
Ray Dalio recommending 'a bit of Bitcoin' and BTC seeking support near $77K suggests the macro bid remains but upside momentum is slowing.
